findings.snippet: objects.write("emitter", pose, previous, allow = history.available, revision = geometryRevision)
findings.issue: The snippet creates a fresh FrameHistory and gates object validity on history.available without ever calling capture. FrameHistory initializes available=false and only capture can advance it, so following the shown per-render sequence keeps correspondence invalid even on consecutive rendered frames. The prose asks for capture but does not show its inputs or order.
findings.proposed_change: Show history.capture(renderer.frameCounter, viewProjection, width, height, sceneEpoch) immediately before objects.begin/write, naming these externally supplied render inputs and keeping history allocation outside the per-frame block. Adapt the actual camera.capture order used by flow_grain.yaml.
findings.verification: Compile the revised snippet with concrete render inputs; exercise two consecutive frame IDs and verify previous[4] becomes 1, then resize or change the scene epoch and verify it returns to 0. No runtime behavior has been tested in this review.

verification_needed: Compile the revised MotionItems integration with actual view-projection, target dimensions and epoch; check valid history on a second consecutive render and invalidation on resize or epoch change.
